english.title: Fail to deliver dog up for purposes of direction in relation to suspended disqualification order
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having possession of a dog, namely **(..SPECIFY DESCRIPTION OF DOG..) to which an order under

(A)_[section 66]_
(B)_[section 67]_

of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 applied, failed to comply with a requirement imposed under section 70(3)(d) of that Act to deliver it up for the purposes of the direction about how the dog to which the order applied was to be dealt with during the suspension of the order under section 70, in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 70(4) and (5) of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022.
